weaknesses.title: No NTHBYFWHERE — kth pick cannot filter by status
weaknesses.detail: NTHBYF is fleet-wide only. Filtered runner-up needs TOPNBYFWHERE K=i+1 then SYS NTH i, or SORTBYFWHERE+NTH glue.
weaknesses.repro: NTHBYFWHERE unknown form; nth_fleet 0 returns drain n2 not hottest ready

weaknesses.title: TOPN bag is names only — no paired load values
weaknesses.detail: Drain list is object names; agents must GETF each or GETFWHERE for loads.

weaknesses.title: K>TOTAL silent clamp; K=0 empty with TOTAL still set
weaknesses.detail: REQ records requested K but N=min(K,TOTAL). K=0 yields empty bag without soft miss flag beyond N=0.
weaknesses.repro: K=99 N=2 REQ=99; K=0 N=0 TOTAL=2

weaknesses.title: Status equality only for TOPN filter
weaknesses.detail: Cannot top-N across ready|idle multi-status without two queries.

weaknesses.title: TOPNBYFWHERE arg order is field N matchfield matchval
weaknesses.detail: Easy to misorder as status before N (silent wrong match).
weaknesses.repro: TOPNBYFWHERE Node load 2 status ready DESC

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE/K softens
weaknesses.detail: REQUIRE=abc → soft; bad K keeps default.
